turns.text: Hello, I moved today and need to update the delivery address for my order.
Please send your order number, the email address you used to place the order, and your full new delivery address.
The order number is SC-4040 and my email is george.miller.v2@example.com. New address is Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara.
Your order has already shipped, so I couldn’t update the delivery address. I’ve handed this over to a colleague who will take over and check what options are available.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer george.miller.v2@example.com moved today and requests delivery to Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara for SC-4040. Policy check denied the change because the order already shipped. No change filed; please review available options.
